title: Jellyfin
comment: Jellyfin's --datadir (data/, config/, plugins/, root/) carries as one tree; the transcoding cache is not carried, the image has its own /cache volume. The Daemonless image runs it with --datadir /config, the same layout as the official jellyfin/jellyfin image (JELLYFIN_DATA_DIR=/config, settings in /config/config). The LinuxServer images are deliberately NOT listed (the internal development record): they hardcode JELLYFIN_DATA_DIR=/config/data and JELLYFIN_CONFIG_DIR=/config, so carrying their /config as one tree lands the database at /config/data/data and the settings at /config -- the server starts empty and still answers on 8096. Unlisted, an lsio bundle has no recipe: native is unavailable and the compat tier is still offered. A second layout needs per-image source layouts (the internal development record); do not re-add them here.
